name: Nervous System
vision_statement: The AI system watches every run and brings in a person only where only a person can decide.
opportunities: A run can be watched at a fraction of the cost of the work it watches: a small model reads a digest of the run and sends one signal (proceed, redirect, answer now, escalate to deep work, escalate to a person). That opens ground the parent solution does not cover: which risks deserve a response of their own instead of one uniform treatment, which questions about a run a plain check can answer without a model, and how a step only a person may take is put before the right person with the work held until they answer.
solution_coherence: Nervous System watches every run and acts when only a person can decide. Quest Decision Requests carries that decision to the teammate it belongs to, holds the ask on the quest until it is answered and never takes the step without them.
